transcript: Interview Guide. Activity E. FGD:  Aspirations of Youth
Module 1:  Agency, education and innovation (1 hour)

Position of the majority of young [sex of FGD] on the ladder of power and freedom (private rating): 5 = Power and freedom to make almost all major life decisions: 1 vote; 3 = Power and freedom to make some major life decisions: 7 votes; 2 = Only a small amount of power and freedom: 2 votes
We are too young and dependent on parents,
we do not make own money.
We have no life experience in dealing with real life.
We have to consult with parents in the next 10 years at least on steps in our life.
I already make my own money from carpenter work and my parents like providing with me with freedom to act in my life.
Education is real opportunity to find one’s place in life,
education opens the door of opportunities.
Even though we live in rural area, education helps farmers to better manage farmland and households to get more money from same plot.
If someone wants to make a career, education is a must.
Boys are required to attend 9 grades of school and finish college, it is mandatory.
Girls too.
All boys and girls should finish college to find a job and be able to survive in modern life.
If someone wants to be a doctor or teacher, university level is required.
Parents show similar commitment to educating daughters as their sons,
but for university education girls should live in cities, which, until recently was not acceptable for truly oriental families.
However, if education requires a lot of money, parents prefer financing sons’ university education to daughters’ university education.
Boys know in general everything related to agriculture – planting, seeding, fertilizers application, cultivation, harvesting and basic processing.

Reasons for ending education
• Leaving to city for work
• Health
• Family conditions (poverty, handicapped parent)
• Need to work to help family

Two most important reasons
• Health (1)
• Family condition (2)
If boy becomes too sick and cannot attend school and college.
If one of parents become handicapped, boys usually need to start working for money to support family.
Every such case is a concern for makhalla committee and makhalla tries to find best possible solution like arranging social assistance for family.
To complete military service and become a military personal and serve 20 years in the army. (2 students plan to be military personal).
I want to be a doctor, but do not know in which area. I plan to enter medical academy in XX next year.
I want to work in XX city in tourism, I learn Russian and English languages.
Most young men work in the village, most ambitious take entry tests to university but most of them fail,
they try to find job in XX city or even in XX to make money enough for wedding and marriage.
If young men want to live in the village they start working for a farmer and learn about agricultural activities.
Young men should study and find a job to their interest and dream. They can start working any time,
no need to do so right after college.

New agricultural or NRM practices
• Machinery
• Fertilizers
• New varieties of crops
• Proper irrigation in high salinity areas
• (Proper irrigation would be leaching after crop season to decrease the content of salt in the soil.)

Most important for the [sex of the FGD] of the community (top 2)
• Machinery (2)
• New varieties (1)

Most important for the [opposite sex of FGD] of the community (top 2)
• Fertilizers (1)
• New varieties (2)
Men are mainly involved in large scale farming as farmer or field worker, therefore, wheat and cotton production are most important for men, especially new cotton and wheat varieties,
new developments in machinery also are most important for men.
Women mainly work in household plots growing vegetables for sale, fertilizers are important to grow healthy harvest,
yet new varieties of wheat and vegetables are becoming more popular among women as restaurants in XX demand specific quality bread and vegetables.
In general, young women have similar opportunities, yet not same.
Young women are expected to be at home before evening, they have plenty of home duties to do,
farming is male dominated too.
In vegetable growth, poultry and milk fermenting women have advantages, provided they are within households plot area.
7 out 10 young men agreed that young women have less opportunities to learn about and try out new farming practices or agricultural organizations.
Module 2.  Gender norms, livelihoods, and family formation (1 ½ hours)

Important crops or livestock for [sex of FGD] Now
• Livestock
• Melon
• Wheat

Important crops or livestock for [sex of FGD] Ten years ago
• Wheat
• Melon
• Livestock
Livestock become backbone for men to generate income, there is demand year around.
Meat price almost double within 10 years.
Wheat yield worsened due to lack of water for irrigation and non-rainy spring.
Yes, as it is because of customs, strength of men and women and household bound activities, men usually are out of house daytime.
Nowadays no problems with such attempts by young women, results and profitability are of more importance.
In fact young women are better at selling in markets as they are really good at bargaining and selling more than young men.
Delivery and transportation are key difficulties as young men need to hire a taxi or wait for fathers or brothers to have spare time to provide their car for delivery of produces to markets.
As for raising a major crop, we do not face any difficulties only lack of water.
If household has farmland and household plot, men mainly work on farmland and women on household plot as it is closer to house
and smaller plot requires only manual labor, not machinery. Spouses discuss what to grow yet final decision is up to husband.
Men can do some heavy work on their wives’ plots when needed and usually early morning before leaving for farmland.
Women might help with husbands plots in addition to hiring other women to take care of cotton growing.
Otherwise women are busy only with household plots.
As women’s plots are household plots, family members might join women in cultivating plot for vegetable growing especially in summer vacation time.
Family members also help on men’s plots with cotton cultivation in summer vacation time.
Woman consults her husband at first, if he suggests someone else for better consultation like agronomist or successful farmer.
Men might inform wives on their plan with new crop, but consults with professionals like agronomist.
If Ana is too young with small children, probably Adam’s answer would be No,
if she can handle both household duties and grow vegetables with a group of local women – Yes is quite possible.
Again, if no negative affect on household duties, Adam would not mind Ana to sell vegetables in market, daytime only.
No, additional activity by Ana should not affect her usual routine of activities.
There is high uncertainty about success of her new activity anyway,
but established activities are backbone for family income.
Nothing exceptional like 20 years ago, today it is normal for women to work and bring additional money to family.
Mary’s reputation should not change at all.
Younger men would not change their mind about Mark
however, older men might blame him for forcing Mary to work out of house.
Mark will redirect his time and efforts to new small enterprise by Mary as it is more profitable for family. Cash is king!
Gender equality, in our opinion, is when women are more active in family and public life, not housewives anymore.
it is good progress as women are not fully used resource in our society.
In oriental family woman should be respectful to husband in private and public, slightly lower in position.
Yet we witness families where wife has a voice result in better living standard, healthier and more educated children.
Men should listen to women’s advices and inner voice, as she wants only best for her family.
Both of them have saying in such decisions, yet both would like to sell more keeping produces of lower quality for own consumption.
Diana might share her plan/idea about how much to sell, but final decision is up to David.
It takes no more than 5 minutes to discuss this matter and make a final decision.
Both can sell depending who is busier and who can go to market to sell vegetables.
In market though more and more women are sellers,
right today David would be better person to sell vegetables in this family.
If her sister tried this new farming practice, Diana and David would most probably try out this practice too, provided it is not to expensive, only replacing one practice with new one.
They might try out in small plot first.

How easy or difficult for Diana to purchase the plot of land without David’s support (private rating): 1 = Very easy: 0 votes; 2 = Easy: 0 votes; 3 = Neither easy nor difficult: 3 votes; 4 = Difficult: 7 votes; 5 = Very difficult: 0 votes
For Diana to go ahead and spend her inheritance without David’s support? Agreed rating: 4 = Difficult
Financial and large-scale decisions are up to husbands, so Diana should consult with and seek for a permission from David.
For David to go ahead and spend his inheritance without Diana’s support? Agreed rating: 4 = Difficult
David is a head of family, yet he has responsibility and wasting even unexpected money is not acceptable.
David would consult Diana, but not seek her permission, only her ideas and suggestions.
Young women are allowed to walk freely alone to local market, preferably daytime only.
According to customs and religion, she needs to get a permission from husband or mother-in-law to leave house, even to local market.
Used to be hard for a woman to sell in the local market, but in last 5 years more and more women sell in the local market,
they are in fact better to attract customers and better at bargaining.

Out of every 10 women, how many move freely on their own in public spaces (private rating): 1 (practically no women move freely on their own in the village): 0 votes; 2: 0 votes; 3: 0 votes; 4: 0 votes; 5: 2 votes; 6: 7 votes; 7: 1 vote; 8: 0 votes; 9: 0 votes; 10 (practically all women move freely on their own in the village): 0 votes
If needed, woman can go to public places, daytime and with knowledge of husband and senior family member, but Aimless or just visits are not welcomed.
Young men have comparative freedom to choose where and how to work.
Young men are expected to earn money for their wedding events and costs, and usually follow brothers or close relatives in cities or even in Russia.
No restrictions unless they are youngest sons in families.
Usually family covers initial cost of moving and living in new place with new job.
If he returns, buys car and build new house, people will think of him as successful person.
If he returns with almost no money, they are considered to be lazy and failed persons.
They are believed to have enough money to finance new farming practices by family members.
Still they have similar opportunities to live and work in the village.
Woman’s age is between 19 and 21,
Young men are expected to have stable work,
women to finish college and have some minor job or home-based employment.
Nowadays young women and men share their desire and wish to get married with certain woman or man with parents.
If families are friendly to each other, in most cases such desires are approved by both families and wedding plans are agreed.
If man or woman is too shy, parents can arrange a marriage for them, but now it is very rare case, though even 15 years ago it was normal.
It is our life and and we have not just to talk but we have to make right decision on who to marry!
From my brother and sisters cases I can say my decision to be respected by my parents.
Plans and hopes are different among young men, better to avoid marrying a woman and leaving for XX city for years.
Within 1 year after marriage, so between age of 20 and 22.
It depends on mother’s health, but usually after 20 it is good age to have first child.
From medical point of view, it is better not to have a child before the age of 19 after 35.
Age of 21 is best as woman is ready take care of very weak child, can arrange medical support for newborn and to have 3 children by age of 30.
Women decide and consult with husbands,
but first child is expected to be born within first year of marriage so parents can be happy grandparents
Number of children to have is decided by spouses taking into account their future plans and finances.
To be fully independent and ambitious, we need money!
We wish there are many more well paying jobs in our village or close to it.
We want to stay and live happy life in our village with parents, relatives and friends without need to go to Tashkent city and Russia.
If water and power supply is guaranteed, many local rich people can open such enterprises to produce quality products and process agricultural products.
